tiktok-app-marketing v1.0.0

- Initial release automating TikTok and Instagram slideshow marketing for any app or product.
- Features competitor research, AI image generation, and text overlay for social posts.
- Supports multi-platform posting via Upload-Post API, with integrated analytics and per-post tracking.
- Includes a feedback loop for optimizing hooks, CTAs, and conversions using post analytics and optional RevenueCat integration.
